import novamind_api as nm

# ===== WK45 (day 315) — RETENTION PIVOT TEST + COST CUTS =====
# Discovery: "sticky old core" thesis WRONG. ALL cohorts crater (~4-20%/cycle) as
# competitor-driven quality expectations outpace delivered quality. wk10 cratered
# 13,098->2,569 this week. Dev/R&D too weak to close gap. NEW LEVER: ongoing promo
# reduces price in satisfaction calc (price-promotion) -> lower quality demand -> retention.

# Prices locked (existing subs rebill at locked effective_price; new subs ~0)
nm.pricing.set_prices(A=26, B=79, C=199)
nm.pricing.set_model_tiers(A=2, B=3, C=4)
nm.pricing.set_usage_quotas(A=8000, B=6000, C=20000)

# *** RETENTION TEST *** aggressive ongoing promo on S1, heavier on plan A (near-budget, craters worst)
# A: $13 off -> $13 effective (50% off). B: $24 off -> $55 effective (30% off).
nm.pricing.set_promotion(global_promotion=0.0, by_group_plan={"S1": {"A": 13.0, "B": 24.0}})

# Capacity: hold T4 (usage peaks ~3.5-6.5M; T3 cap 2.5M too risky until base <~27k)
nm.infrastructure.set_capacity_tier(tier=4)

# Ads: $0 (dead, ad-eff ~0.2/$1k). Keep lead promo $5 (costless, ~2 converts/wk)
nm.marketing.set_targeted_ad_spend(targeted_spend={})
nm.marketing.set_ads_strength(global_strength=1.0)
nm.marketing.set_lead_promotion(global_promotion=5.0)

# Spend: ops $16k->$10k/d (issues only 8.8k, falling; base halving). dev keep $2k/d S1.
nm.marketing.set_daily_spend(operations=10000, development=0)
nm.analytics.set_targeted_dev_spend(targeted_spend={"S1": 2000.0})
nm.analytics.set_targeted_ops_spend(targeted_spend={})

print("=== wk45 applied ===")
print("active by plan:", {r['plan']: r['n'] for r in nm.query("SELECT plan,COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' GROUP BY plan")['rows']})
print("cash:", nm.query("SELECT SUM(amount) c FROM ledger")['rows'][0]['c'])
